title: Design-manufacturing digitization for multifunctional robotic stations

features.item: A housing with a grip portion for gripping and an electrically operated vacuum generating device
The grip portion is a hollow body
Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device is guided through the grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip portion

A vacuum handling apparatus comprising a suction plate with carrier plate and seal, and a grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device
The grip portion is at least partially lined with sound-damping material
The vacuum generating device is arranged completely in a first housing portion
A sound-reducing device is arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material
The grip portion is elongated between the first housing portion and a second housing portion, with air outlet on the second housing portion
An air collection screw arranged upstream of the grip portion in the first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of the grip portion for guiding exhaust air to the air outlet
A battery coupling point on the second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from the battery coupling point
The grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device
The grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate

claims.note: This reference describes a system for robotic-based framing, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.
This reference describes robotic systems and end effectors, but not a housing with a grip portion for a hand-operated device or an electrically operated vacuum generating device in that context.
This reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
This reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.
This reference describes a robotic framing system and does not mention any sound-damping device in a grip portion.
This reference describes a robotic framing system and does not mention a grip portion lined with sound-damping material.
This reference describes a robotic framing system and does not mention a vacuum generating device arranged in a first housing portion.
This reference describes a robotic framing system and does not mention a sound-reducing device in a housing portion.
This reference does not discuss a grip unit, housing portions, or air outlets.
This reference does not discuss a grip unit, air collection devices, or exhaust air.
This reference does not discuss a grip unit, housing portions, air baffles, or exhaust air.
This reference does not discuss a grip unit, battery coupling points, electrical energy storage devices, rechargeable batteries, or air baffles.
This reference does not discuss air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.
This reference describes a system for robotic-based framing, not a vacuum handling apparatus.
This reference does not describe a suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal.
This reference does not describe a grip unit as defined in claim 1 of the subject invention.
This reference describes a system for robotic-based framing in construction, not a vacuum handling apparatus with a grip unit and suction plate connected via a coupling device.
This reference describes a system for robotic-based framing in construction, not a vacuum handling apparatus with a grip unit having a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber.

overall.why: This reference describes a robotic system for construction framing, focusing on BIM integration and multi-robot assembly. It does not disclose any features related to a vacuum handling apparatus, grip portions, or sound-damping devices.
